function.arguments: {"reason": "The initial raw difference in response rates was confounded by severity imbalance. The treatment group had a much higher proportion of severe cases, which are less likely to respond, leading to a misleading negative raw effect. However, stratified analysis and IPW both show a positive treatment effect within each severity stratum and a consistent weighted effect of +14.3 percentage points. This is the true causal effect. The confounding was resolved by adjustment, so the final estimate is valid."}
function.name: resolve_finding
